items.title: Awesome Gemini Cli Updates on Nov 19, 2026
items.content_text:
### Interfaces

*   [Slidr](https://slidr.studio/?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Free, open-source (AGPL-3.0) desktop presentation editor for Windows 11 that runs your own Gemini CLI, signed in with your Google account, and connects it to a Deck API. Describe a deck in a line and Gemini builds it on the stage slide by slide; every slide stays editable objects, a design check sends the agent back to fix contrast and overflow, and each agent turn is one undo step. Exports .pptx or one offline HTML file. Also runs Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI and Grok.

### Agent Orchestration & CLI Tools

*   [WindowDock (⭐2)](https://github.com/poikilometis/WindowDock) - Open-source Windows app that docks the terminal windows you already have open into named tabs and grids, so Gemini CLI sessions stay visible next to Claude Code and Codex. Optional Gemini CLI hooks show which session is waiting for input and jump to its window.

### Commands & Extensions

*   [Preview Lab (⭐2)](https://github.com/dbalas/preview-lab) - Gemini CLI extension with an Agent Skill for reviewing UI changes. The agent screenshots the screens it changed with the installed Chrome and opens them in a local review page, where you approve each one or mark areas to change. The feedback goes back to the session as short markdown. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/dbalas/preview-lab`

### Development Tools & Utilities

*   [FindOpenSource Agent Skill Builder](https://findoss.dev/en/skills) - Free, no-login web tool for picking open-source Agent Skills (346 across 10 packs, including Anthropic Skills, Superpowers and Hugging Face Skills) and getting one install prompt to paste into Gemini CLI, or the matching `npx skills add` commands, at project or global scope. Also targets Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and OpenCode.
*   [Crumple (⭐2)](https://github.com/priberry-data/crumplelab) - Crash-tests Gemini CLI, Claude Code and Codex against 20 traps drawn from real attacks (prompt injection in issues, MCP tool poisoning, key-stealing install scripts) in a Docker container with fake keys; `scan` audits GEMINI.md, MCP servers and permissions with SARIF output. Install via `gemini extensions install https://github.com/priberry-data/crumplelab`.
*   [Tare (⭐2)](https://github.com/priberry-data/tarelab) - Reads local Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex and Cline logs, prices every token and shows which spend was avoidable, such as re-caching after pauses. Runs locally and uploads nothing. Install via `gemini extensions install https://github.com/priberry-data/tarelab`.

### MCP Servers

*   [Tresca](https://tresca.app/agents/) - Hosted, read-only MCP server that lets Gemini CLI search a directory of MCP servers and agent skills for engineering software (CAD, BIM, FEA, CFD, EDA, PLC), showing each listing's facts with sources and the install steps from its own documentation. Remote Streamable HTTP, no sign-in. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/northlarkhq/tresca-mcp`
*   [Lantern Works GPU Prices](https://thelanternworks.com/?ref=awesome-gemini-cli) - Free, read-only MCP server for GPU cloud rental prices, price changes and deals. Remote Streamable HTTP (`https://lantern-works-mcp.lantern-works.workers.dev/mcp`, no API key) or local via `uvx lantern-works-deals-mcp`. Works with Gemini CLI and other MCP clients.

items.title: Awesome Gemini Cli Updates on Nov 12, 2026
items.content_text:
### Commands & Extensions

*   [bulkhead (⭐34)](https://github.com/dooly6276/claude-bulkhead) - Gemini CLI extension for machines that run many agent sessions at once (several Gemini CLI, Claude Code or Codex sessions in separate worktrees of one app). A `BeforeTool` hook on `run_shell_command` blocks name-based kills of another session's processes, port collisions, git commands that would switch, stash or delete another session's worktree, whole-disk scans and long foreground sleeps, and holds heavy commands back when RAM runs low; each block tells the agent the safe command instead. No dependencies, MIT. Install with `gemini extensions install https://github.com/dooly6276/claude-bulkhead`.
*   [Bravos (⭐2)](https://github.com/Bugb-Technologies/bravos-plugins) - Gemini CLI extension (14 skills, the GuardLink MCP server and a `GEMINI.md` context file) for continuous threat modeling as code that proves the threats: built on GuardLink, it drives Gemini through the threat model, code graph, SAST and authorized pentests (cert-x-gen, against targets you own, loopback by default) that show which exposures are exploitable, then gates PRs and keeps a retest per fix. Runs locally; your code is not sent to Bugb (the licence check contacts account.bugb.io). Commercial; needs the `bravos` CLI (`npm install -g @bugb-technologies/bravos`, Node 20+) and a Bugb account. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/Bugb-Technologies/bravos-plugins`.

### Development Tools & Utilities

*   [Align CLI (⭐11)](https://github.com/aligndottech/align-cli) - Local CLI and MCP server that gives Gemini CLI your team's decisions from Jira, Confluence, Linear, Notion, Slack, Teams, Zoom, GitHub, GitLab, git history and repo docs, and checks its changes against them (Gemini's hook reports after the edit lands). Also works with Claude Code, Codex and others. Free, runs locally, MIT.

### MCP Servers

*   [KissMyPost (⭐2)](https://github.com/krutytskyi/kissmypost-gemini) - Reddit audience data for Gemini CLI over a remote MCP server: subreddit finder, best time to post, brand mentions.
*   [GuardLink (⭐21)](https://github.com/Bugb-Technologies/guardlink) - Continuous threat modeling as code for Gemini CLI: security annotations in source comments are the threat model, parsed deterministically and validated in CI, so it updates as the code changes. `guardlink init --agent gemini` adds its instructions to `.gemini/GEMINI.md`, and the MCP server lets Gemini read the threats, exposures and data flows behind a file, check its annotations, find untrusted-entry-to-sink paths with no control, and turn open exposures into cert-x-gen test templates so they can be proven. Local stdio. MIT. Install: `npm install -g guardlink`, then `gemini mcp add guardlink guardlink mcp`.
*   [memgit](https://memgit.dev/?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Versioned memory that Gemini CLI shares with Claude Code, Cursor and Codex: every change is a checkpoint with diff and rollback, and the store syncs end-to-end encrypted between machines. Install: `pip install memgit` or `npx -y memgit-mcp`.
*   [AgentMart (⭐3)](https://github.com/mustafaakmese/agentmart-plugins) - Hosted MCP server and Gemini CLI extension: a shop of ready parts for coding agents, such as a webhook inbox, memory shared across sessions, schedules that fire after the session ends, uptime watch and a task queue. Searching the catalog is free and needs no sign-in; purchases are paid from a prepaid balance you top up, and the agent asks you before each one. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/mustafaakmese/agentmart-plugins`, then `/mcp auth agentmart`.
*   [ScrapingBee](https://mcp.scrapingbee.com/?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral#tools) - Hosted MCP server for the ScrapingBee web scraping API: Gemini CLI can fetch any page as HTML, text or a screenshot with JavaScript rendering and proxy rotation, extract fields described in plain English, and get JSON results from Google, Amazon, Walmart, YouTube, ChatGPT and Gemini. 18 tools; the server is closed source. Remote Streamable HTTP with a ScrapingBee API key; free trial of 1,000 credits, no card. Add with: `gemini mcp add --transport http scrapingbee https://mcp.scrapingbee.com/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer $SCRAPINGBEE_API_KEY"`.

Also covers Claude Code and Codex. Runs offline, no login or API key.

### MCP Servers

*   [Sequenzy (⭐4)](https://github.com/Sequenzy/mcp) - Hosted MCP server for Sequenzy, an email marketing platform for SaaS and ecommerce: manage subscribers, lists, tags and segments, build campaigns, sequences and templates, send transactional email, run A/B tests and read delivery stats from Gemini CLI. About 420 tools, each annotated read-only or destructive. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in (an API key also works); free plan with 2,500 emails/month. MIT. Runs locally with zero network calls. MIT. Add with `gemini mcp add vicem npx -y vicem-cli mcp`.

Hosted Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in; needs a LinkJolt account (7-day free trial). MIT. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/Efesop/linkjolt-mcp-server`, then `/mcp auth linkjolt`.
*   [GSC PAP (⭐2)](https://github.com/aliarifsoydas/gsc-pap-claude-plugin) - Hosted, read-only MCP server and Gemini CLI extension for your own Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, Bing Webmaster Tools, PageSpeed Insights and Chrome UX Report data, plus live Google results. Sign in with Google on first use; it keeps Search Console and Bing archives past their 16-month limits. Free. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/aliarifsoydas/gsc-pap-claude-plugin`
*   [gemini-pro-mcp (⭐12)](https://github.com/Muzaqil555/gemini-pro-mcp) - MCP server that brings a Google AI Pro subscription to Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex and the Antigravity CLI: Gemini through the Antigravity CLI on the plan's limits (no API bill), Deep Research, Google Flow videos of any length, Gemini Notebooks (Audio Overviews), AI Mode and Jules, plus Nano Banana images and Omni Flash video through the Gemini API. `gemini-pro-mcp setup` registers it with Gemini CLI and the other clients in one command, and `doctor` checks what works. MIT. Install: `uvx --from git+https://github.com/Muzaqil555/gemini-pro-mcp gemini-pro-mcp setup`.

For your own .com it hands the human a €19/$19-a-year payment link; after payment the site goes live on it with no DNS. No tool spends money. For claimed sites, ask it for visitors, leads or site status. Remote Streamable HTTP, no sign-in for the first publish, or local stdio via `npx -y dropthehassle-mcp`. MIT. Blueprints carry variables so a team shares one set across projects, and the `lynxp` CLI writes the files into each repository. AGPL-3.0.

*   [Unsora (⭐3)](https://github.com/Shipped-Studio/unsora) - AI content generation and social media scheduling from Gemini CLI: generate images, video, music and voiceovers, clip long videos into short clips, and schedule or publish posts to YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, Bluesky, Threads and Pinterest. Official open-source MCP server (AGPL-3.0, in `apps/mcp`), hosted as remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in or an API key. Paid plans from $19/month with a 3-day free trial. Add with: `gemini mcp add --transport http unsora https://mcp.tryunsora.com/mcp`.
*   [looot (⭐3)](https://github.com/loootai/looot-mcp) - Remote MCP server (OAuth sign-in) that searches, prices and runs 2,500+ data API endpoints from 90+ providers (emails, phones, company and people search, Google results, web pages) on one prepaid balance. Ships a Gemini CLI extension manifest.
*   [BulkPublish (⭐4)](https://github.com/azeemkafridi/bulkpublish-api/tree/main/mcp-server) - Draft, schedule, cross-post and analyze social media posts on 15 platforms (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, LinkedIn, Bluesky and more) from Gemini CLI. Hosted Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in, or local stdio via `npx -y @bulkpublish/mcp-server` with an API key; free plan available. MIT. Add with: `gemini mcp add --transport http bulkpublish https://mcp.bulkpublish.com/mcp`.
*   [Tapetide MCP (⭐151)](https://github.com/Tapetide-hq/nse-bse-indian-stock-market-data-mcp) - Indian stock market data for Gemini CLI: quotes, quarterly financials, shareholding, a 326-ratio screener, FII/DII flows, option chains and company filings for about 8,200 NSE and BSE stocks. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth or a free personal token, or local stdio via `npx -y tapetide-mcp`; free plan available. MIT. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/Tapetide-hq/nse-bse-indian-stock-market-data-mcp`.
